Claudio has become a very real beast, all because of Rosemarie's accidental theft of his mana many years prior! Claudio's life and future are on the line until he gets his mana back — and Rosemarie would give anything to know how to do it. Will they break their mutual curse in time for Rosemarie to get home for tea, or will Claudio lose his temper first? Find out in this new romantic fantasy.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: Apparently it's My Fault That My Husband Has The Head of a Beast
title.native: 旦那様の頭が獣なのはどうも私のせいらしい
title.romaji: Danna-sama no Atama ga Kemono na no wa Doumo Watashi no Sei Rashii

104484.description: Similar to the TV Anime, HIkari and Karen watched "Starlight" when they were young and promised to stand on the same stage in the future... Karen, although a sleepyhead, continues to study the path of the Stage Girl everyday! However, due to her tardiness, the selected students were subjected to the 'Legandary Training' that would make them into 'Top Stars'...? And soon... they will all be singing, dancing and taking from one another by following the mysterious audition started by Souda-sensei and... a Giraffe!?

title.native: 舞台 少女☆歌劇 レヴュースタァライト ―The LIVE― SHOW MUST GO ON
title.romaji: Shoujo☆Kageki Revue Starlight: The LIVE - SHOW MUST GO ON

104485.description: "Even though he should be an impertinent, irritating and hateful junior..." An encounter with an impolite and rude junior in a P.E. class full of boys!?

title.romaji: Kimi to Watashii no Taiiku no Jikan

104487.description:
It's 2020 and Tokyo is on fire! A large, mysterious creature rampages through the city destroying everything in its path. Cut to 1959. We meet a spunky young girl, Asa. As one of 11 siblings, Asa is constantly forgotten. Most people can't even remember her name. So, when she is kidnapped for ransom (by a guy who mistakes her for a doctor's kid), no one bats an eye—not even when a typhoon hits! Now Asa and her kidnapper must work together to survive the brutal storm. But there's more to her kidnapper and this storm than meets the eye.

(Source: VIZ Media)
synonyms: 連続漫画小説 あさドラ！

104488.description:
Na Bonggu's a professional when it comes to pleasing women - which makes him the perfect host (ie. gigolo). After a night spent in a motel with a rich female client, he's approached by someone he presumes is a female con-artist: Seulbi. Turns out Seulbi's got a connection that can help him pay off his 3 million dollar debt. The two of them meet a Madam Hong, who tasks them with seducing five wealthy ladies. But the job isn't without its dangers: Bonggu and Seulbi are forced to wear shock collars outfitted with a tracking device. They must complete their mission... or pay the price.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ホスト DE 一発逆転

104491.description:
Per a request from his assistant to get his house cleaned, ero manga artist Asahina—nickname Hina—hires a cleaning service. However, the person who shows up is actually Asahina’s beloved Sahara-senpai from his junior high days! Sahara was cool, able to do anything, but was just a bit mean. Hina, who loved that Sahara, made a brave decision. On the day that he was supposed to transfer schools, he confessed! But instead of waiting for a reply from Sahara, he ran away… After that, ten years later – their reunion becomes a nightmare?!

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)
synonyms: เผลอใจรัก เจ้าชายสาย S

104492.description:
1-2) Taka to Tonbi to Aburaage (タカとトンビと油アゲ)
Hanajima is the most popular and sought-after guy in school. But he has a secret: a hidden self, who is unbearably egoistical in both words and thoughts! The only one who knows that is a fellow schoolmate, Nodate!

3-4) Kyou no Makino wa Oyasumi desu (今日の槙野はお休みです)
5) Futari no Gohan (ふたりのごはん)
6) Futari no Asa Gohan (ふたりの朝ごはん)
7) Taka to Tonbi: Sonogo (タカとトンビ その後)

title.native: タカとトンビと油アゲ

104493.description:
On his 20th birthday, Sawamura Eita is kissed by his best friend. The were both a bit drunk at the time, so Eita is content to believe it was all a dream. But was it?

(Source: mangaudates.com)
synonyms: Aruhi Hyouhenshita Shinyu ni Kokuhakusa Remashita.

title.native: ある日、豹変した親友に告白されました。
title.romaji: Aru Hi, Hyouhenshita Shinyu ni Kokuhakusa Remashita.

104494.description:
The peak of martial arts is solitary and lonely. It is an endless pursuit for unattainable heights as well. In order to surpass the limits of martial arts, growth and the will to survive in adverse situations is necessary. One day, Yang Kai, a disciple-on-trial (and floor sweeper) of the Lingxiao Martial Arts Sect discovered a Wordless Black Book. That marked the turn in his luck and the beginning of his martial arts journey.

(Source: Webnovel)

104495.description:
Welcome to a new world of immortal cultivation, based on Fengshen Yanyi. There is Emperor Zhou. Other main characters like Jiang Ziya, Su Daji, and Yang Jian all have new roles. There are the three kings of Huoyun Cave and the three sages of Daomen. The beasts and villains are here, too, Chi You and Xing Tian. Into this world comes the boy Luo Lie, who will rewrite Fengshen Yanyi by not becoming a hero, but by becoming invincible!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

104496.description: Aiko Oshitani is a new teacher worried about how she'll get along with her students. Her students noticed her misgivings and came to class the next day ready to support her. Glowsticks in hand, they'll cheer on Aiko like their favorite idol! What will the other teachers say when they see such a thing…

title.native: 推させて！ Myティーチャー

104497.description:
Her father was missing when she was 3 years old; her hand tendon was cut when she was 15; her mother died in a planned car accident when she was 16; she was framed by her relatives when she was 19; she was burnt alive by her newlywed husband and friend when she was 22. Perhaps the god pities her and makes her reborn to the age of 15. She kept a low profile in the previous life but ended up with being betrayed miserably; this time she will not show any weakness and make those who harmed her pay with their lives!

(Source: Webcomics)

104498.description:
A young girl wakes up in a hotel room and sees a man lying on top of her, but all she can remember is having a drink with her sister. Luckily she manages to escape from more terror, but still ends up pregnant. She passes out after giving birth, and when she wakes up her stepsister and stepmother can no longer be found in the hospital...
Five years later, she moves to Ningguo as an exchange med student, and with her is her 5 year old son who walks into another kid with identical appearance.
synonyms: เจ้าชายมาดนิ่งกับที่รักส่วนตัว

104500.description: The various, daily life of the female student who hates love, Han Yeonsil. A romcom you can relate to!

104501.description:
The student Junpei Koganei is preparing for the entrance exams of university, but is invited by a friend from high school to join the AV company "Apollo Productions".

(Source: Wikipedia)

Young man trying to find a job becomes enticed by the only female staff member to work for an AV studio as a male actor. Antics and comedy ensue as their relationship gradually improves.

Included one-shots: Volume 11: Ishikawa-senpai Monogatari, Aishite My Hero, Sensei-chan, Ganbatte, Pretty Cute

104502.description:
Souta Takatsuki and his neighbor Rikka Amanome have been like brother and sister since they were kids, but his feelings for her run much deeper. With her birthday coming up, he wants to find the perfect gift, which presents itself in the form of a book from a mysterious shop he happens across. The owner doesn’t even charge him, saying he’ll return to pay eventually…Souta is wholly unprepared for the insatiable passion the book inspires in Rikka, and it seems the ultimate price of this gift may be hefty indeed…

(Source: Yen Press)

104503.description:
Office worker Leon is reincarnated into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire…of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.
synonyms: The World of Otome Games is a Tough for Mobs
ชีวิตตัวประกอบอย่างตูช่างอยู่ยากเมื่ออยู่ในโลกเกมจีบหนุ่ม

title.english: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs
title.native: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です
title.romaji: Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu

104504.description:
Office worker Leon is reincarnated into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire…of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: The World of Otome Games is a Tough for Mobs
ชีวิตตัวประกอบอย่างตูช่างอยู่ยาก เมื่ออยู่ในโลกเกมจีบหนุ่ม
女性向遊戲世界對路人角色很不友好

title.english: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs
title.native: 乙女ゲー世界はモブに厳しい世界です
title.romaji: Otomege Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu

104505.description:
Yoshida is just your average salaryman, drowning his tears in booze. On his way home one night, he finds a runaway high school girl sitting on the street. She offers to sleep with him in exchange for a place to stay―and Yoshida lets her off the hook and offers her work instead. A rom-com between the most unbalanced couple you'll ever find!

(Source: One Peace Books)
synonyms: I Shaved. Then I Brought a High School Girl Home.
โกนหนวดไปทำงาน แล้วกลับบ้านมาพบเธอ

title.english: Higehiro: After Getting Rejected, I Shaved and Took in a High School Runaway
title.native: ひげを剃る。そして女子高生を拾う。
title.romaji: Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou.

104508.description:
Both men and women can't help but be attracted to Shin. Tachibana feels a sense of superiority when Shin begs him to make him feel good. Tachibana finds himself more and more attracted to the loyal tease Shin, but then Shin starts distancing himself from Tachibana...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: You do not have to laugh

104511.description: Yuzuru is not very popular in high school. Despite his beautiful face his closed personality prevents him from making friends. If he goes home as soon as classes are over, it’s not for pleasure but to take care of his sick older brother. Now, after many years he reunites with his childhood friend, Kotarou. Being open and friendly, Kotarou doesn’t hesitate to invite Yuzuru to hang out with him and his friends after class, despite his constant protests. Worried about his brother, will Yuzuru choose to repel or seize that hand?

title.native: 出会わなければよかったの

104512.description:
In the heart of the Sengoku era, an age of endless conflict, one name thundered across the waves: the Murakami Kaizoku.
These pirates, masters of the Seto Inland Sea, were led by the immensely powerful Takeyoshi Murakami. But it was his daughter, Kyo, who truly inherited his fierce courage and untamable spirit.
Devoting her life to piracy and battle, Kyo is infamous in her hometown as a fearsome, ugly shrew whom no man would dare make his wife. The tale begins as this unlikely princess sets a course for Naniwa on the eve of a decisive battle, a journey that will plunge her into the heart of history.

(Source: Shinchosha)

104513.description: ──This is not a story of heroes. It is the story of a demon who spreads the Law of Might.

title.native: 装甲悪鬼村正 魔界編

104515.description:
Their love was stained with the smell of the beast... The man's name is Akimia. Occupation: Pest exterminator. The woman's name is Saw. Occupation: Sanitary soldier. Is it possible for love to bloom?

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

104516.description:
Bad luck! My dad kicked me out of the house! Then revenge a playboy whose grandfather was a gangster! That's not all! I go to the noble school to be the maid of four demons...

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Spicy Girl Fight Evil Young Master

104517.description: As the world is in the middle of an industrial revolution, a monster appears that cannot be defeated unless its heart, which is protected by a layer of iron, is pierced. By infecting humans with its bite, the monster can create aggressive and undead creatures known as Kabane. On the island Hinomoto, located in the far east, people have built stations to shelter themselves from these creatures. People access the station, as well as transport wares between them, with the help of a locomotive running on steam, called Hayajiro. Ikoma, a boy who lives in the Aragane station and helps to build Hayajiro, creates his own weapon called Tsuranukizutsu in order to defeat the creatures. One day, as he waits for an opportunity to use his weapon, he meets a girl named Mumei, who is excused from the mandatory Kabane inspection. During the night, Ikoma meets Mumei again as he sees Hayajiro going out of control. The staff on the locomotive has turned into the creatures. The station, now under attack by Kabane, is the opportunity Ikoma has been looking for.

104518.description:
"So you want me to kill you? How about I have my way with you instead?" He's touching me in places I've never been touched, and it feels like my whole body's on fire... I'm saying "no," but my body's saying "yes," and this sensation's driving me crazy...!! My name is Tsubaki Sawada. Not only did my fiance leave me at the altar, he also took all of my money. I was totally scammed. Dejected, I jump in front of a car, hoping to end it all. Except, the car belongs to yakuza member Tomoe Fujita, and I end up damaging the car. He's making me pay, but I'm broke... Hey, how about he kills me and takes my life insurance? But he'd rather I pay him with my body! Scammed by my fiance, picked up by the yakuza, enslaved for my body... my life just took a whole new turn!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Gangster, the Girl, and the Scent of Love and Money
title.native: 任侠男子と金蔓女子～あなたのにおいに染め上げて
title.romaji: Ninkyou Danshi to Kanezuru Joshi: Anata no Nioi ni Someagete

104519.description: Aika is a 28 year old teacher who lives her day to day full of harmony in the nursery where she works. She tries so hard in her work, she does not have time to go out and find a boyfriend. But this is until Shibuya-san comes into her life, a mysterious boy who will make her routine change completely.

104520.description: Karin Shinonome is a very unlucky girl. Very. After a terrible morning she is late to her first day at a new school but everything ends with a very strange gamble... When all seemed lost she is saved by her history teacher... That also hates gambling!

title.native: ギャンブラーズパレード

104521.description:
Hanamaru Kunikida, a first year student at Uranohoshi Girl's Academy and a member of the school idol group Aqours, has been given an important mission: writing a manga to promote Aqours!

(Source: ComicWalker)
synonyms: ラブライブ!サンシャイン!! マルのヨンコマ
Love Live! Sunshine!! Maru no Yonkoma

104522.description:
Everyone in the world uses smartphone apps. But inside them lurks unknown creatures called "Appli Monsters," or "Appmon." The Appmon are AI lifeforms with the ability to think and act, and exist in the boundary between the human world and digital space to allow people and the system to interface and function. But in the vast sea of the internet, the "last boss AI" Leviathan takes control of the Appmon with a virus and begins hacking every system, thus starting to control the human world from the world of the net.

The protagonist, Haru Shinkai, is led to acquiring the Appli Drive and uses it to materialize Gacchimon, a search app monster. What is the secret hidden within the Appli Drive? What is the mysterious field that exists between net world where the Appmon exist, and the real world? What is the "App Combine" that can combine two Appmons? What is Leviathan's true goal?

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: デジモンユニバース　アプリモンスターズ

104523.description:
Keisuke Amazawa goes to the DigiMarket, where he remembers how he got his partners, Betamon, Tentomon, and Gotsumon. Not happy, he challenges the owners of the market and has to fight against their Triceramon, Tyrannomon, and Monochromon.

(Source: Digimon Wiki)

title.native: デジモンストーリー サイバースルゥース
title.romaji: Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth - Hacker's Memory

104524.description: Takumi Aiba, a new Cyber Sleuth, takes on an account raiding case as part of his assistant job at Kuremi Detective Agency, and sets out to the man-made cyberspace known as "EDEN" to recover the accounts of the victims with the help of his Digimon.

title.native: デジモンストーリー サイバースルゥース

104525.description:
There's this one guy who never comes to Sumire's counter at the convenience store where she works. "Again!?" she thinks, annoyed, until he falls to the floor right in front of her, and she ends up having to carry him up to his apartment. When she gets there, she realizes he's a... manga artist!! On top of that, he begs her to help him with his manga, and she does.

The two are from completely different worlds, but with this sudden proximity, Sumire starts to realize how much fun she has with him. She wants to get to know him more... help him more! Or, so she tries to do, but... Includes other cute and spicy love stories!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Manga Artist and the Ditz

104526.description:
In order for her family to save their inn, Asuka is to be wed to a guy she's never met before. Then, while on a trip with her friends, she meets a dashing hunk. Even though they've only spoken briefly, she can't get him out of her mind. Asuka knows she shouldn't let herself fall for him, but her growing passion becomes unstoppable... His sweet and mesmerizing kisses, his fingertips gently rubbing her skin, everything he does brings Asuka to the brink of pure ecstasy. Since she decided this could only be a one-night stand, Asuka leaves the next morning without saying a word. However, the guy then shows up as a guest at her parents' inn...

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Wet Flower Bud Blossoms During The Intimate Night
title.native: 濡れた蕾は密夜に花開く
title.romaji: Nureta Tsubomi wa Mitsu Yoru ni Hanahiraku

104532.description: The one-shot tells a story about the late Kenji Endō, the real-life musician that was the inspiration for Kenji from 20th Century Boys!

title.native: いっつあびゅうてぃふるでい

104533.description:
Ba-Reum’s planner might be full, but one thing she desperately needs in her diary is a date. When she is lured into joining a programming club by her friend’s hot coworker, it looks like there might be hope for her. But will her inexperience lead to her downfall? And why does she keep running into his bad-tempered friend instead?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title.native: PG14（パラグラフ・フォーティーン）

104536.description:
Somewhere out there, is a small shopping arcade full of quirky, mysterious stores. There you can meet with a lace-seller who deals in ornate lacework left behind by the deceased or find yourself in a shop that sells "artificial animal eyes".

Follow the young landlady of the arcade as she interacts with the store owners, their customers, and the magical objects they deal in, interacting with spirits and drawing on powers from beyond the grave.

synonyms: 詩人獨自徘徊 -種田山頭火外傳-

title.native: まっすぐな道でさみしい ～種田山頭火外伝～

104538.description: PIPPI, a humanoid computer developed to predict earthquakes, estimates that a global-scale cataclysm will occur in eight years. Though the computer also announces that the accompanying danger of human extinction can be avoided by taking a series of specific steps, the process deviates so far from normality that people are thrown into a state of chaos and doubt.

104539.description:
“A love story involving a normal guy and his obsessive girlfriend.”

Karuizawa Ryo is a third-year middle schooler who has a crush on a cute, smart, and popular girl named Omoi Miton. After hearing that Omoi is going to an all-girls high school, Karuizawa decides to confess his feelings to her. To his surprise, she agrees to date him! But... now what? Meanwhile, Omoi has everything planned from the get-go, including transferring to his high school, getting married in two years, and setting up insane rules for their relationship. Because of that, Karuizawa realizes what kind of a person Omoi truly is; a girl with an overwhelming obsession with relationships! Despite his concerns, their dating life begins, painting his high school life in a totally different color.

(Source: Comikey)

Notes:
- Serialisation of the original webmanga.
- Includes one bonus chapter.

title.native: おもいがおもいおもいさん

104540.description:
Kyoko is at the autumn of her life.

She can barely recognise her own family member. But one day, someone she remembers perfectly comes to visit. Her name is Mitsu, the woman Kiyoko had a love story with. Just after the war, when they were still teenagers, they nearly did the irredeemable out of passion.
Despite a few meetings from time to time, life ups and downs separated them, but the story draws us back in the time when they couldn't imagine life without each other.

(Source: Atelier Akatombo, translated)

104541.description:
Mikage suffers working at a black company. His desk piled with energy drinks and a never ending pile of paperwork.
In an environment where there should only be despair, all he hears is insane laughter from his neighbour.
synonyms: ブラック企業へようこそ！

104542.description:
1. Bougekka
2. Onibi no Yoru
3-5. Noboru Asahi ni Kuchizuke wo

title.native: 昇る朝日にくちづけを

104548.description:
Shimabara is a famous brothel in Tokyo. Gorgeous male courtesans with amazing techniques in bed take female customers to paradise each day. They captivate countless women with their skills. Will you be able to bear the sensual ecstasy of the sometimes fierce, sometimes sweet skills of Ibara, the number one courtesan?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Courtesans of Shimabara -Come, Ask for Me-
title.native: エロメン遊郭～俺を買ったらイかせてやるよ～
title.romaji: Eromen Yuukaku: Ore wo Kattara Ikasete Yaruyo

title.native: サトラレ～嘘つきたちの憂鬱～

104550.description:
The story of the "Three Jinnai from Edo" (Kosaka, Tobisawa, Shoji) Eight year of the Keicho era, 3 years after the Battle of Sekigahara (1603 AD) Okubo Nagayasu calls on Kosaka Jinnai, who is known as the best thief in Japan, to eliminate the bandit gang led by Fuma Kotaro. A fierce battle between the Jinnais and the Fuma clan opens its curtain !!

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, edited)

104551.description:
Mahoro Haruta is a manga artist whose first series became a huge bestseller. Her publisher expects her sophomore effort to be even better. There's just one problem: Mahoro has no idea what to draw next, because she plagiarized the story that skyrocketed her to stardom from a high school classmate named Yukishima, who shared a few precious months with Mahoro in the school's manga club before passing away and leaving her his notebook filled with all his story ideas. When, after a strange encounter, Mahoro wakes up ten years in the past—around the time of her first meeting with Yukishima—she realizes this could be her chance to redeem herself, erase her regrets, and maybe even save Yukishima’s life...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Earliest Spring in the World

104560.description:
1. Omoibito
2. Sarishi Hi ni Mita Ai no Hana
3. Angel no Yuuutsu
4. Natsu no Mamono
5. Juugo no Kokuhaku

104561.description:
The day of her mother's funeral service, Minato Ootani, a 21 years old university student, meet Natsuki and Fuyuki, two lost children...

The story of a college student thrown away by her mother and two lost children looking for their parents.

104571.description: The daily lives of Korean siblings everywhere!
synonyms: The Daily Lives of Us Siblings

104572.description:
Minami is working toward her dream of becoming an actress in Tokyo when she is reunited with her childhood sweetheart, a man she hasn't seen in over a decade. Ten years earlier, when they were both in high school, Yamato suddenly abandoned Minami in their rural home town. Why did he leave without a word...? After being reunited, the two lovers ravage each other as though trying to fill every second that was stolen from their relationship. Minami slowly copes with her first physical passions and her rekindled feelings for her lost love, but Yamato has a secret that prevents him from being with her forever...

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: 10 Nen Go Bed de Majiwaru Hatsukoi

title.english: First-Time Lovers Reunited in Bed After Ten Years

104573.description:
Torao is a delinquent who's always eager to let his fists do the talking. His greatest enemy is Ryohei, both the strongest guy in school and a terrible womanizer. When Torao tries to get revenge for the time Ryohei humiliated him in a fight, his plans are thwarted by a mysterious potion that turns him into a girl. From that point on, Torao (now Torako) develops a steamy and complicated relationship with the boy he hates! But, is hate really the only thing on Torao's mind!?

(Source: Renta!)
synonyms: Nyotaika Yanki Gakuen ☆ Ore no Hajimete, Nerawaretemasu.
女體化的不良學園☆本大爺的初體驗被他給盯上了。

title.english: Gender-Swap at the Delinquent Academy -He's Trying to Get My First Time!-
title.native: 女体化ヤンキー学園☆オレのハジメテ、狙われてます。
title.romaji: Nyotaika Yankee Gakuen☆: Ore no Hajimete, Nerawaretemasu.

104579.description: Tenko Harukaze is a girl who loves to eat and she will participate in a tournament to find out if she is able to eat as much as possible.

104582.description: Twelve stories, each focusing on different residents of a large high-rise. The setting is a high-rise in the midst of remodeling, so the old and new are mixed in. Adults and children, the wealthy and poor, those lonely and warm. Through all those windows and doors, each and every one of them lives their own life. “This Year’s Fireworks”, a young couple who moved in when they got married have their first summer together and their second fireworks display. “Walk the Night”, a young office worker misses the last train of the night, and has a long, long night walk before he reaches his apartment. “My Apartment Complex”, a widower has lived there for many years. With the complex being so completely remodeled, what will his daughter think of the new place? Includes nine other stories about the residents.

title.native: サザンウィンドウ・サザンドア

104583.description:
Gear up for a magical new adventure! In a world where magic abounds, 15-year-old Anti Kythera is the odd one out. No matter how hard she studies, she can’t even use the most basic of skills. Her only hope is her upcoming Skill Bestowal: a ceremony that can help even the chronically magicless discover their talent. But what Anti receives is something completely new: Gearcraft, a skill that allows her to make and control golden gears! What can a restaurant owner’s daughter, much less an aspiring adventurer, do with gears? As it turns out, quite a bit. But it’s going to take a little imagination, and a lot of effort, if she’s going to discover the secrets of this never-before-seen power. Can Anti tame the tiara-shaped artifact that calls itself “Crown Gear”? Will she ever become as great as her idol, Purple Lightning? Join her as she gets into gear for a life of adventure!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

104584.description:
Shun is the new kid in school, but he’s already managed to attract the attention of the school bully, who’s now making his life a living hell. It doesn’t seem like things could get any worse, until the night he finds himself and a group of his classmates inside a creepy, abandoned mansion known as the Jailhouse. They quickly start to hear strange sounds and see weird things, but everything escalates when they realize they can’t get out. Once they’re trapped inside, a blue, unnaturally large figure chases after them. Is it a new species? Or is it the ghost of their old classmate who died in an accident? Nobody knows, but one thing is for certain... If it catches them, they’re dead! The scariest game of tag in history begins!

(Source: J-Novel)

104585.description: Arihara Keigo - he excels in any role he plays, and he has a few awards under his acting. Arihara meets Matsushita, an idol and his co-star who struggles with acting. One day, Matsushita mistakes the dressing room and discovers Arihara's secret. The "aloof and mysterious" Arihara that everyone loves is actually a clutz with a sweet tooth! As the two become friends, Matsushita becomes interested in Arihara's real personality...!?

title.native: 有原さんの秘密の事情

104586.description:
Vegetarian food columnist Shin Chaekyung is a man of mysteries. He spends most days tucked away in his rundown apartment, cooking, writing, and humming to his favorite tunes. But fans can’t get enough of his food—his dishes are known to tickle the taste buds with flavors that vegetables alone can’t quite achieve. So, what is his secret...? Only those invited to dinner get to find out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue.

104587.description:
14 years ago, a high school student committed suicide. The cause was depression. On the night this news was reported, four people wearing the same school uniform as the student who committed suicide secretly sneaked to the scene of the incident. 14 years later, what is the truth contained in the envelope of documents delivered to the detective with an unknown address?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

104588.description:
We’ve all been there—a couple drinks too many, and a hazy wander back to your home, where you wake up wondering how you got there. But in Kaede’s case, not only was she not sure how she got home … she wasn’t sure how the dinosaur got there, either! The two are soon fast friends, but though their personalities jive, they’ll have to learn how to communicate in order to live peacefully together!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

104589.description:
The manga centers on high school student Kazusa Kamishiro, whose mother announces suddenly one day that they have a new family. Among the new family members is a young girl named Nonoko, who Kazusa saw once in a dream. In addition, Nonoko starts saying she's a god.

(Source: Anime News Network)

104595.description:
Rumor has it that there is a witch inside room 13 of the girls' dormitory, who lures innocent, unsuspecting girls into her room at night to perform indecent acts on them....

In truth, the girl in room 13, Herazato Shie, is just unable to fall asleep at night unless she tells someone a story about the movies she has watched. So every night, she invites anyone willing to come in her room and listen to another of her stories about movies.

(Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

title.native: おやすみシェヘラザード

104596.description:
When a down-on-her-luck student runs out of money – and hope – it’s time for the devil to make his entrance and give her an offer she can’t refuse. But this devil has problems of his own. He’s a cog in Satan’s corporate ladder, who’s quickly losing credibility because that same desperate girl isn’t ready to part with her soul willingly. Now, she’s working at his coffee shop while he tries to convince her that she can have it all. And the cost? Merely her mortal soul…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Love Contract with the Devil

104597.description: Eight stories about relationships with older women.

104598.description:
With an intimidating face and aura, Kayama, a male highschool student, isolates himself from his surroundings. With no friends nor lover, Kayama rushes to get home everyday before sunset. That is because...

Includes 3 bonus chapters and 2 epilogue volumes consisting of 7 chapters and 1 bonus chapter in each.

title.native: 彼は彼女に変わるので
title.romaji: Kare wa Kanojo ni Kawaru node

104599.description:
Even though Chihiro is Shuto's cousin, his neighbor, and a guy, Shuto has had feelings for him for five years. Shuto knows nothing good could come from these feelings. That doesn't stop Shuto from kissing his cousin...and touching himself. When Chihiro catches Shuto kissing him, Shuto soon realize his unrequited love might still have hope.

(Source: Futekiya)

104600.description: It all started with the sound of feral insects. Women infected with this sound became known as the "crazies" who infect other women and attack men exclusively. The resulting chaos devastated Japan's populations as 70 percent perished, forcing the international community to cut off Japan from the rest of the world.

104601.description:
"It's the world's fastest conversion to comic form for a hot-topic anime!! The special taskforce 'SEVEN-O' - tasked with shutting down and investigating the illegal drug 'Anthem' - is organised into duos called the 'Double Decker System', who interact with each other. The aloof veteran Doug Billingham and the eager newbie Kirill Vrubel, who spends his time frivolously getting nowhere. This unconventional pair's story begins now..."

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title.native: ゆるりと海と時々イルカ
title.romaji: Yururi to Umi to Tokidoki Iruka

104603.description: 4koma manga about daily life of the characters from the mobile game Bang Dream! Girls Band Party.

104604.description:
Ryota Sakamaki is a struggling artist who finally gets his big break when his manga series is serialized. Sakamaki’s life is thrown into turmoil, however, when he learns that his backgrounds are drawn by an inmate charged with the infamous Halloween Murder. But is his assistant truly guilty of that heinous crime?!

The manga is commemorating the 50th anniversary of Weekly Shonen Jump.

(Source: VIZ Media)

104605.description:
There’s a new school nurse at Mitsugi Middle School, and the students couldn’t be more ex­cited. To everyone else, Momoyama-sensei is an unmatched beauty, but second-year student Tamotsu Kurita sees something they don’t—that she’s also a massive nerd! Her love of 2D characters—and only 2D characters—knows no bounds, and try as she might, she just can’t hide it. To Kurita, being around a beautiful lady who shares his interests is a dream come true, but Momoyama-sensei’s more excited to talk about her favorite fictional idols than anything else...

Note: includes 2 extra chapters
synonyms: Do You Like Nerdy Women in the Health Room?
Do You Like the Otaku School Nurse?
ชอบรึเปล่า? พี่สาวโอตาคุที่ห้องพยาบาลน่ะ ?

title.english: Do You Like the Nerdy Nurse?
title.native: 保健室のおたくおねえさんは好きですか？
title.romaji: Hokenshitsu no Otaku Onee-san wa Suki desu ka?

104606.description:
“I like you, Yuichi”
“Huh?!”
“I wanted to tell you before I took time off school. Is that weird? I’m sorry.”

Yuichi was suddenly confessed to by his childhood friend, Chihiro. Chihiro will be taking time off school... What’s going on?!
However, Yuichi begins to notice Chihiro’s increasing number of injuries and unsettled emotions, as well as the strong attraction he feels towards Chihiro, whose true feelings only hurt himself. Young, inexperienced and clumsy. But that’s what makes them all the more sinful and heartwarming! A story of a life changing romance between two childhood friends.

104608.description: Kurono Maou is a high school student who is sensitive to his sharp eyes and bad expression. With no girlfriend, but gifted with friends in his own way, he had been living a peaceful life. One day, without any reason, Kurono was attacked by a mysterious headache while in the literature clubroom and fainted. When he finally awoke...swords and magic, filled with monsters, an orthodox different world summoning.

104609.description:
An online comic by HIRANO Ryo, an artist active in a wide range of fields such as video and animation. Influenced by the occult culture of “Hollow Earth” theories, a mysterious world existing within a rubberlike cavity in the earth becomes the setting for the story, in which links are drawn with reality. An entire world of cuteness and pop is gradually revealed to the reader.

(Source: Japan Media Arts Festival)

title.native: ファンタスティック ワールド

104610.description: Isaki Aiko, a normal thirty-one-year old office worker, had just been dumped by her boyfriend of ten years. She treats herself to sushi in order to feel happier.

104612.description: Takayukashiki-san knows many different things (especially, about perverted things). With it, will you become a little wiser and a little more perverted. A comedy manga that will satisfy your perverted curiosity!

title.native: 変な知識に詳しい彼女 高床式草子さん
title.romaji: Hen na Chishiki ni Kuwashii Kanojo Takayukashiki Souko-san

104614.description:
Deep in the forest lies a mysterious school of magic: Wizdoms, an institution attended by beastmen of all kinds. These studious fantasy creatures have come to live, learn, and perhaps even fall in love in this enchanting space. In this collection of BL stories by master mangaka Nagabe, follow the beauty and surprising humor of magical beasts with human hearts.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: 巫茲魔法學院的獸人們

title.english: The Wize Wize Beasts of the Wizarding Wizdoms
title.native: ウィズダムズのけものたち

104615.description:

104616.description: A special booklet released by Kodansha on October 9, 2018 bundled with a special edition of Volume 3.
synonyms: I wanna Toy With Miss Nagatoro!!

title.native: 長瀞さんを、イジりたいっ！！

104617.description:
​Seventeen years ago, Takafumi’s uncle fell into a coma, but now he’s back like a man risen from his grave. Soon, Takafumi discovers two bizarre things: His uncle treasures video games above all else, and, while comatose, he was actually transported to another world as some heroic guardian! Now, not only does Takafumi have to room with an uncle who is literally magical, he also has to catch the guy up on two decades of history—smartphones, high-speed internet, modern anime tropes…and the traumatic outcome of the ’90s console war!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: ยอดคุณน้าจากต่างโลก
Coma héroïque dans un autre monde

104618.description:
Androgynous Aoi has a traumatic past that makes it difficult for him to get the true satisfaction he desires. Meanwhile, Aoi's classmate, Takano, the rough class outsider, makes a move on Aoi whenever he has the chance. Aoi doesn't take him seriously in the beginning, however...

(Source: Kodansha USA)

104619.description:

2) Tokimeki Jittei Twins (ときめき実弟ツインズ); 2012-05
3) Oshiri Oukiku Naimon☆ (お尻大きくないもんっ☆); 2012-06

10) Nama☆Oto (ナマ☆オト); 2012-01
11) Natsuyasumi☆Otoko no Ko (ナツヤスミ☆オトコノコ); 2012-09

104620.description:
Young cafe worker Yuki dreams of romance and a life far more wonderful than her own, but has no way to do anything but hope for the future – but a chance encounter with the beautiful, mysterious authoress Azuma Beniko, a woman who seems to know love like the back of her hand, might change the very way she looks at the world…

Note: Includes chapter 7.5 (Cat) and an epilogue.

104621.description: After having fell into the sea, the producer of an idol group wakes up from a coma to find a woman with the face of a fish waiting for him.
synonyms: Be an Idoll Who can Take You To The Seashore

104624.description:
Xiang Xingzi has misandria, and will hiccup whenever a boy touches her. She is surprised to find that she doesn't hiccup when touched by the boy who transfers here after being expelled from his previous school because of doing something bad. She is recognized while disguising herself in men's clothes in her mother's restaurant, and finds that boy is also her neighbor and often gets good grades. She is curious about him.

(Source: Webnovel)

104625.description: Fragments tells the independent stories of Li Chang Ge, Ashina Sun, Situ Langlang and Mo Ying. It is aimed to help readers enter the delicate inner world of each character, showing the unknown past and richer personalities of the characters.

104626.description: As a result of getting addicted to an MMORPG during exam times, high school 2nd year Xiao Nan is moved back to the normal courses.On the first day of school he goes to his new class, unexpectedly meeting his childhood friend, Su Luo, who he hasn't talked with for 10 years.What will happen between these 2 boys united by a common interest? Includes Ch. 0 - Preview

104627.description: The adventures of a writer, Hodaka Rika. A girl with a cycling hobby and a love of food.

title.romaji: Hodaka Rinka no Chari to Meshi.

title.native: あなたの順位おしえてくださいっ

104634.description: Plain Jane full-time housewife Sumika, who’s always in casual clothes, has lived a life free of any inconveniences. Lately though, she’s started to get suspicious of her easy-going husband Takumi’s behaviour, and she consults her neighbours for advice.

104635.description: The story of two girls with a shared love of books falling in love at the library.
synonyms: Pages in search of a bookmark

title.native: しおりを探すページたち

104636.description:
Top fashion model Yuria has a reputation for being aloof. When young manager Okabe Ayumi is assigned to her due to the previous manager being injured, she can barely get the model to acknowledge her, much less anyone else.

Chapter count includes two extras.

title.native: モデルちゃんと地味マネさん

104637.description: Ace student Chizuru transfers to a boarding school where elegant and gorgeous girls are gathered. It is a school where special health check-ups and top-level curriculum are seen as the ordinary.
synonyms: The Caged Bird Sings Theme Of Love.
Kago no Shoujo wa Koi o suru

title.romaji: Kago no Shoujo wa Koi wo suru

104638.description:
A manly girl met a girly man when they found out the affair between her fiance and his fiancee. After one night together, they were forced to play a couple and started learning from each other to become more "marriageable". But when they finally found someone "ideal" to marry to, they began to realize who's their true love...

(Source: Webcomics App)

104639.description:
I am born in a family who make a living by robbing tombs. Its retribution accelerates and befalls in my fate—I have to marry to a power ghost. He says, "I am waiting for you for 20 years." I, "You are a ghost. Why don't you marry a ghost too?"

(Source: Webcomics App)

title.romaji: Bao Jin Wo De Gui Fujun

104640.description: After performing in their final middle school judo tournament, Michi and Sanae begin high school and walk in on Michi's final opponent fighting to save their new high school's judo club.

104641.description:
Hina is a high-school student who enjoys cooking and is very sweet and kind. Unbeknownst to any of her friends, she is going out with a neighbor – an older woman – named Yayoi. Yayoi works at home and it is Hina’s great joy to make Yayoi food and gently scold her about taking care of herself. Yayoi knows she wants to marry Hina one day, and make this arrangement formal.

(Source: Okazu)

Includes seven extras.

104645.description: Ren is a fifteen-year-old boy who is self-conscious about his small stature. Mistreated by his peers, he feels powerless in their presence and bottles up his anger every day. However, fate leads this high school student to discover an art that will unleash his hidden talent: judo. Ren embarks on "the path of flexibility" with unwavering enthusiasm and tenacity, which will be the keys to his ascent!

title.native: 葬送 2011.3.11母校が遺体安置所になった日
title.romaji: Sousou: 2011.3.11 Bokou ga Itaianchisho ni Natta Hi

104648.description:
The adventure story of Prince Corgi Roland and Louisa the witch. The secrets of the high priest's past and the church, which were hidden in the veil, are finally revealed...

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

104649.description: The adventures of a Pomeranian, Mochi, and his life partner, Shiratama.

104650.description:
1) Closet: Osananajimi no Shinjitsu (クローゼット～幼馴染の真実～, The Truth About His Childhood Friend)
2) Closet 0: Ubawareta Junketsu (クローゼット0～奪われた純潔～, Stolen Innocence)
3) Closet 2: Kanojo no Ketsumatsu (クローゼット2～彼女の結末～, Her Conclusion)

クローゼット2～彼女の結末～

104651.description:
A young boy witnessed his mother having sex with some guy in an amateur porno video.

(Source: dlsite)

title.native: 熟れた体を持て余した未亡人と即ハメできるSNSがあるって本当ですか?
title.romaji: Ureta Karada wo Moteamashita Miboujin to Sokuhame Dekiru SNS ga Arutte Hontou desu ka?

104652.description:
"Psycho-Seek" - The ability to directly interact a persons' dreams and unconscious thoughts.

Mutsuki has been selected to be one of those who investigates the increase in crime among the youth, and she does so by exploring what they keep hidden.

title.native: 痩せたいさんと失恋ちゃん
痩せたいさんと失恋ちゃん

104655.description:
Souichirou Hibiki is a bartender at a bar in Shonan. He is usually cool and mysterious, but he has a secret he doesn't want people to know: he is a "secret fudanshi otaku," and he is always trying to make the customers who come to the bar for drinks into his favorite coupling, secretly fantasizing about them and worshipping their precious relationships.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 腐男子バーテンダーの嗜み

104656.description:
"Let's have fun together in the Railway Club!" Tenman Sora has fallen in an unrequited love for the Railway Club's Mahiro-sensei! "No matter how thorny the trains may be, if it's for Sensei, just bring it on..." The pinnacle of heart-throbbing excitement. We sincerely invite you on a tingly girls-exclusive railway journey!

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

104657.description: While many girls her age want to join the band or chorus, Misaki Nonoka wants to lead students in music by being the conductor.

104658.description: A collection of unique, fantastical short stories featuring quirky, mysterious characters.

title.native: 路地裏第一区 ―ムライ作品集―

104659.description:
Kagari Shuuya found himself inside a white room where he was shown a futuristic interface to reincarnate in another world. He was given choices of race and 4 extra skills. Among the myriad of races up for selection, he chose to be a half-vampire, a race similar to human in appearance, but has most of the advantages of a vampire with the sole weakness of Light attribute magic. But he exploited that weakness by choosing an extra skill that allows him to use Light magic. That combination somehow produced a brand new species that unites light and darkness, Seivalt. The other 3 extra skills were Language Comprehension, Chain Projection, and Growth Modifier.

With such cheaty line-ups he was transported to another world, but the destination was a very severe place that even with his cheats it’s not easy to survive, the vast underground world. He could beat most enemies, but there’s no way out, there’s no people, a world of loneliness. After few months surviving in that dark world, he braved himself to venture even further. There he encountered a white giant winged beast, an apostle, which instantly made holes in his body and consuming flesh. As his wounds were healing, he kept running until he reached an altar that enshrined a black tiger statue. The apostle caught up to him and they commenced a life and death battle. Shuuya’s body was torn apart and his flesh littered the area, but then his vampiric blood went berserk and the predator changed. The apostle got her blood and soul drained and Shuuya lost his consciousness. In the silence, Shuuya’s flesh and blood gathered and formed into a small cute black cat. In the distant past, it was called a Divine Beast, now it’s a cute cat that will accompany Shuuya in his adventures.

104660.description:
Surviving a zombie apocalypse beats being a wage slave any day! After spending years slaving away for a soul-crushing company, Akira's life has lost its luster. He lives in a trash-filled apartment, his pay is abysmal, and he can't even muster up the nerve to confess his love to his beautiful co-worker. But when a zombie apocalypse ravages his town, it gives him the push he needs to live for himself. Now Akira's on a mission to complete all 100 items on his bucket list before he...well, kicks the bucket.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Volume 1 contains a bonus chapter titled "Sakura Mochi Of The Dead" Note: Volume 4 contains a bonus chapter titled "Show Club of the Dead"
synonyms: Zombie 100 ~100 Things I Want to do Before I Become a Zombie~
Zombie 100 ~Zombie ni Naru Made ni Shitai 100 no Koto~

Zombie 100 – Bucket List of the Dead

104661.description:
The manga centers on an office worker whose wife leaves him, a beautician who falls in love with someone only by their voice, and a female office worker who meets her former bully.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: アイネクライネナハトムジーク

104662.description:
Sahoko had lots of friends in high school, so there’s no shortage of people to catch up with at her reunion. But the one face she wants to see is missing: that of Aoi Koshiba, her classmate and first love. A star of the basketball team, Aoi caught Sahoko’s eye as an easy way to score social points. But when Aoi quits the team, an unexpected kiss pulls Sahoko closer to her than she intended to be. With a difficult home situation, Aoi is in need of more than just a cynical social climber. She needs a true friend, and something more…

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Chapter count includes Chapter 0.

หากวันนี้ได้พบกับโคชิบะ อาโออิ
如果，今天能見到小柴葵。

104664.description:
Washed up on the shores of a deserted island at the edge of the East Blue Sea, two men from different backgrounds unite in their shared thirst for adventure. One of them, Portgaz D. Ace, will follow in his infamous father’s footsteps as the fearless captain of a pirate crew. The other, Masked Deuce, becomes the reluctant first member of Ace’s Spade Pirates. Survival is not enough for these seafaring buccaneers, as together they seek treasure, excitement, and a route to the New World.

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Both volumes contain a prologue.
synonyms: ワンピース novel エース
ONE PIECE novel A 원피스 노벨 에이스

104666.description: Aoi Yagi's mother decided to get remarried to… the Demon Lord! Which means Aoi's beautiful classmate Mira Koganezaki is now her step-sister, and it turns out that Mira is a half-vampire, too. It's all a little too much to handle!?

104667.description:
Succumbing to long-simmering jealousy over her younger sister, noblewoman Violette snaps and does something terrible. As she languishes in prison, something unexpected happens: time is rewound, sending her back to the day she first met her sister! Armed with the memories of her disastrous first go-round, Violette is determined to take the script in a different direction this time.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Den här gången lovar jag att absolut inte vara i vägen!

title.english: I Swear I Won’t Bother You Again!
title.native: 今度は絶対に邪魔しませんっ！
title.romaji: Kondo wa Zettai ni Jama Shimasen!

104668.description:
During Japan’s tumultuous Sengoku period, one man sells his son to a pack of devils in exchange for the power to rule. Forty-eight devils take forty-eight pieces of young Hyakkimaru, and the boy is left for dead. But through the assistance of a sage and a series of inventive prosthetics, Hyakkimaru survives. Together with the young thief Dororo, the now-grown Hyakkimaru embarks upon a quest to slay all the demons and retrieve the stolen pieces of his body.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A remake of the original Dororo work by Osamu Tezuka.

title.english: The Legend of Dororo and Hyakkimaru

104669.description:
The manga centers on the university professor Tim Lawrence. When a freshman student gets an invitation to a strange club, Professor Tim saves him. Professor Tim's words captivate the student, and the student decides to join his seminar.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: テロール教授の怪しい授業

104670.description: The story of a strange family of four.

104671.description: Miyamoto Haruaki has the ability to see ghosts and is a part-time teacher who recently moved into an apartment. The ghost that haunts his room is a high school girl who is only interested in sex...

104672.description:
Usa Ayano is a middle-school girl who is kinda-sorta bad at physical activities. One day at gym class, she sees another girl in her grade, Hoshihara Chika, a transfer student who muddles through the dancing lesson like she couldn't care less.

Ayano, intrigued by how mysterious Chika is, tries to approach the new girl, but gets pushed away. That is until she later discovers Chika's secret...

Uran of the "Mujaki no Rakuen" fame brings you a story bringing together youth, JCs and dancing!

104673.description: Mikan (Idiot), Matcha (Serious), and Kassis (Cool Idiot) are a trio of JK friends. One day, they start playing a famous retro game, "Dragon Journey 3", when they all get sucked into the game screen!? When they wake up, they find themselves in a familiar world in the game!! Fights, deaths, and resurrections abound in their quest to escape this world! Gut-busting adventures of the girls in the game, start!! (This is a comedy manga)

104675.description: A story about a noble female knight and her attempts to lose her virginity to her husband.

title.native: オークが犯してくれない！

104676.description:
The manga that went viral on Twitter!
Girls find it hard to refuse if you just kneel down and beg, even lewd requests!?
Enjoy full-color pages featuring girls' breasts and underwear!!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: The physical edition compiled the 27 chapters of the web edition into 4 chapter.

104677.description:
Based on a Korean folktale, two very different women find themselves making the same wish - to leave this world behind. One is Shim Chong, a young beggar living off the kindness of others to support herself and her blind father. The other is the bride-to-be of old Chancellor Jang, sold off to him for the sake of her family. When Shim Chong rescues this new bride from the river, their relationship triggers both love and hidden intentions. But will these two women be able to find their way forth in a world that favors men?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: Her tale of Shim Chong : Loin des yeux
她的沈清：丞相夫人與她的秘戀

104678.description:
The story is set in Onomichi, Hiroshima in the year 20XX. Fish disappear from the sea around the world and only whales live in the ocean. The Ministry of Fishery decides to set up giant experimental Universe Fish Tanks in space. The Onomichi Universe Fishery Union is established and begins to train space fishermen. Female fishermen are in demand due to the strengthening of an equal employment law for men and women. Six new female space fishermen are selected, and the story centers on supporting their growth.

(Source: Anime News Network)

104680.description:
A 12 year old Edward has just passed the State Alchemist exam and is congratulated by military members. He then departs with Alphonse on their journey. Elsewhere, Shou Tucker has failed the exam, but will try again next year.

Note: Hagane no Renkinjutsushi 0 is a special manga drawn as a bonus for theatergoers for the Hagane no Renkinjutsushi live-action film.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: ビッチギャルパコハメックス

104683.description:
Collection of short stories

1. My First Lady
2. Kimi ga Iru Basho
3. Kara no Soto
4. Anata wo Furimukaseru Tatta Hitotsu no Houhou
5. Koi wa Marude Kiseki no Youna

title.native: マイ・ファーストレディ

104684.description:
The story follows a boy named Shiro and his aunt, Momo, who live together after the death of Shiro's mother, Momo's older sister. Shiro makes bread for Momo in the mornings.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: パンと僕のモモちゃん

104685.description:
Yuu Enji, a boy abandoned by his father, and the oldest kid in his foster home are fed up with adults like his selfish orphanage principal. His dream is to buy the orphanag​e, so that everyone there can live happily together. With that goal in mind, he decided to get a job, and went to his high school graduation. But from that day forward, the world suddenly changed!

Adults have now morphed into giant chickens that attack children! Can Yuu protect the children during this crisis!?

Includes extras 10.5 Egg and 20.5 Pure Human

104686.description:
Long ago, Fujishiro Kosuke promised his love to his childhood friend, Sayaka-chan. But his pledge to save his first sexual experience for her takes a shocking turn when he’s suddenly abducted and thrown into a secret prison–run by beautiful, terrifying women in fetish gear. His seductive kidnappers claim to have a higher purpose but are after one thing: Kosuke’s virginity, and they’re willing to employ every kink at their disposal. Who are these women, and why are they trying to break Kosuke’s promise to Sayaka-chan? In this darkly erotic thriller about fear and desire, one man is about to face a sexual gauntlet like no other.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

104687.description:
Misono is an office drone with his own ups and downs at work, but thankfully, he has an ally: his senpai Shizuka, who happens to be a witch. Shizuka is always ready to lend a hand to those in need, but Misono thinks she should take better care of herself, since zipping around on a broomstick to run errands can be quite stressful. Is Misono’s over-solicitous concern for Shizuka driven by mere respect for this flustered witch, or could it be more? Let this magical romantic comedy cast its spell on you!.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:
Originally published on Pixiv and collated by Akita Shoten for print release.
Now serialised in Akita Shoten's Manga Cross.
Original serialization finished 2020-11-19 with 42 chapters in two volumes. Serialization restarted with new chapters on 2022-04-25.
synonyms: Meine Kollegin, ihr Besen und ich
Báo cáo hằng ngày. về đàn chi phù thủy.

title.english: Daily Report About My Witch Senpai

104688.description: Notes: Nominated to the 24th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

104689.description:
What do you do when the MMO you’ve run for 15 years comes to an end? Akira Ono didn’t get much of a choice — he woke up trapped inside the world of his own game in the body of his in-game character: the Demon Lord. With an outcast child as his sidekick, he tries his best to survive the cruel fantasy world of his own creation, prosecution from the good guys, and of course, the final boss.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Note: Chapter count includes Extra chapters from volumes 1 and 4.
synonyms: จอมมารรีไทร์

104690.description:
When a meteorite struck the Earth, it shattered more than just the land—it broke reality. A wave of madness swept the globe, twisting people into monsters and leaving a cursed few unable to die. Now, in a world of chaos and grotesque wonders, two immortals wander in search of the only thing they still desire: an end.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:
- Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.
- Includes 10 extra chapters.
104690.hashtag: #キリングミーキリングユー
synonyms: キリングミー/キリングユー

104691.description: Tomorrow, we are no longer friends (Ashita wa Tomodachi ja nai) is a collection of individual vignettes with one simple goal: to capture the magical moment right before a couple realizes their mutual affection for each other.

title.english: Tomorrow, we are no longer friends
title.native: 明日はともだちじゃない

104693.description:
Intimate Days by Ikuhana Niiro contains nine chapters featuring confident, slender, sophisticated women playfully getting what they want by deftly enamoring their men with their finer qualities. Whether it's an aloof office lady showing her true colors, chic college women out on a date with her juvenile junior, or a charming, yet pushy, kogal who is increasingly attracted to her nerdy co-worker, in his acclaimed debut, Ikuhana Niiro shares a part of their world by revealing the mature beauty of refined erotic romances.

(Source: Fakku)

1. Hakka (発火, Ignition); Comic Kairakuten 2016-08

104695.description: A remake of the original Shiroi Kyotou novel, now set in Osaka.

104696.description: Because the women in her family are under a generational curse, Akade Soutaro was raised as a man and given a masculine name. One day, she is brought to a slug god who wishes to make her her husband. When Soutarou responds that she's female, the god simply states that she can freely change between sexes. In a mansion with endless rain, the two exchange marital vows. The story of their marriage life as Soutarou struggles with her gender identity and curse.

104697.description: Manga version of the novel The Great Gatsby by F. Scott Fitzgerald.

title.native: グレート・ギャツビー

104698.description:
An existence that transcends time and space! One day, a man takes a bite out of a cake he was having with some tea and suddenly experiences a strange sensation that revives memories of his boyhood. Follow the protagonist as he sets out on a lifelong journey of growth and change, and at the same time gain a glimpse into the world of French high society around the time of the First World War. This is the manga adaptation of the mammoth novel that revolutionized 20th-century​ literature and philosophy with its unique vision of time!

Manga version of In Search of Lost Time by Marcel Proust.
synonyms: En busca del tiempo perdido, el manga

104699.description:
His makeup is flawless! The daily ins-and-outs of an office lady and her beautiful boyfriend.

Wako and her androgynous boyfriend don’t exactly have the most traditional of relationships. She spends her days working hard in the world of publishing, while he spends his time obsessing over fashion and makeup—all with the goal of making himself beautiful just for her. This romantic slice-of-life story is about love, relationships, and breaking with tradition!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: I Am Loved By Genderless Boy
Genderless Danshi ni Ai sarete imasu
I'm Loved By A Genderless Man.

title.native: ジェンダーレス男子に愛されています。

104700.description:
This is the adaptation of the award winning doujin novel that shocked Japan and sold over 130,000 copies within a month. It even outsold Haruki Murakami's long awaited novel, 'Killing Commendatore' domestically.

While in the manga, it claims that it's just a work of fiction, the press release for the book by Fushosha, the publishing company, says (and I quote) "'Otto no Chinpo ga Hairanai' is a shocking true tale that tells the story of a woman's life". Comicalized by Gouto Yukiko (36-do, R-chuugakusei), it's about a relationship between school, society, men and women. About a woman that struggles with the curse that's 'normalcy', her struggle with impotence, cheating, and all that in between. A story of despair and hope, dedicated to all the people who have difficulty living, begins now.
synonyms: Elle ne rentre pas, celle de mon mari

title.native: 夫のちんぽが入らない

104701.description:
Syrup is a white mage that provides support to the Hero candidate, Chrono. They're partied together, and she considers him a father. You can almost say he can do anything as long as he has Syrup with him.

Note: Includes eight extras chapters and three volume-only bonus comics.

title.native: 白魔導師シロップさん

104706.description:
Dad remarried suddenly, and Huo Tianlin, a high school student with a fierce appearance, got two more sisters from Japan! However, these two unexpected sisters have amazing secrets! How will Huo Tianlin get along with them? And how will two girls treat Huo Tianlin?
(Source: Manga Toon)

104707.description: The daily life of a large family of cute little monsters.

104708.description:
Collection of one-shots.

1. Kono Kakegae No Nai Jigoku (このかけがえのない地獄, This Irreplaceable Hell)

104709.description: A story about a strange family.

104710.description:
Mirai is a 13-year-old girl who lives in the human world. One day she witnesses a mysterious object fall from the sky into the park. Excitedly, she brings her stuffed bear Mofurun with her to see what it was. When she gets there she sees a girl named Riko flying on a broom. Riko is of the same age and from the magical world. Mirai has a lot of questions, and Riko explains that she's searching for a jewel with strong powers called "Link Stone Emerald."

Then Batti, an ally of the dark magic users Dokurokushi, appears before them and demands that Riko hand over the "Link Stone Emerald," which Riko herself had been looking for. To make things worse, Batti uses dark magic to create a monster known as a Yokubaru! Mirai and Riko join hands and with the magic words "Cure-up Rapapa!" they transform into the legendary Pretty Cure.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 魔法つかいプリキュア！

104711.description: Spin-off from Drop. Follows the daily life of legendary thug, Tatsuya Iguchi who is not afraid of anything or anyone.

title.native: チキン 「ドロップ」前夜の物語

104713.description:
Shota Kanda is your average 16-year-old first-year in high school. On his way to school with his hot but useless childhood friend Sanae Kondo and his big-chested but shy friend Kana Funami, Sanae's strength gets them killed...literally. They wake up in another world with powers that are not to be believed—Shota's world-class defense against getting slapped becomes world-class defense against demons, Kana's now-magic chest heals all their wounds, and Sanae? Her strength has turned to something truly terrifying. Will the three be able to live in this strange new world, and someday even get back to their own?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

title.native: ポンコツが転生したら存外最強
title.romaji: Ponkotsu ga Tensei Shitara Zongai Saikyou

104714.description:
A typical morning. The usual music. Their normal lives. The peace these seven girls experience will suddenly be destroyed. By the living dead... zombies. A reality that they never wanted a part of, an amazing and terrifying zombie world. They all share one wish: "We want to live." These girls will struggle through this saga, in order to achieve a miracle. MAPPA, Avex Pictures, and Cygames team up to bring you a juicy, 100% original anime. A timeless shocker for all audiences, a brand new style of zombie anime, will soon rise.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

104715.description:
Lazarus "Penny" Kind is a notorious gambler. Knowing very well the ins and outs of the bet, he tries his best to break even - after all, making a bunch of money in one gamble would bankrupt the casino and make him a prime target for criminals and thieves. One night, while idly betting on the roulette wheel, Lazarus suddenly receives a large amount of winnings. Not wanting to become the center of attention, he asks the casino to quickly sell him the most expensive item they have. The casino obliges, giving him a mute slave by the name of Lyla the next day.

Tobakushi wa Orenai won Gold Prize in the 23rd Dengeki Novel Awards.

104716.description:
Lazarus "Penny" Kind is a notorious gambler. Knowing very well the ins and outs of the bet, he tries his best to break even - after all, making a bunch of money in one gamble would bankrupt the casino and make him a prime target for criminals and thieves.

One night, while idly betting on the roulette wheel, Lazarus suddenly receives a large amount of winnings. Not wanting to become the center of attention, he asks the casino to quickly sell him the most expensive item they have. The casino obliges, giving him a mute slave by the name of Lyla the next day.

104717.description:
Omnibus series about several lesbian marriages.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

104719.description:
Micrina is a cheeky witch from the world of demons who is hellbent on taking over the human world. She thought it would be a piece of cake but she arrives in the modern world to find that it has its own powerful 'magic.' She ends up staying with a high school girl named Enomoto after she gets her out of trouble but Enomoto's quirks make completing Micrina's mission more difficult. Still, the witch decides not to give up her conquest.

(Source: Anime News Network)

104720.description: A mild schoolgirl Nazuna and the cool schoolboy Shoutarou unexpectedly and meekly come together in this heartwarming school love comedy.

104724.description:
Roxy’s life is a lonely one–out of all her tribe, she’s the only one without the power of telepathy. Her days pass in silence, while people speak words she can never hear. But when she saves the life of a wandering witch, Roxy gets the chance of a lifetime: the opportunity to study as a magician’s apprentice, and leave her strange home behind! Don’t miss this brand-new tale in the Mushoku Tensei universe: the journey of Roxy, fated to be a star among magicians!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: Mushoku Tensei - Roxy datte Honki desu
เกิดชาตินี้พี่ต้องเทพ บันทึกของร็อกซี
Mushoku Tensei - Les aventures de Roxy

title.native: 無職転生 ~ロキシーだって本気です~
title.romaji: Mushoku Tensei: Roxy datte Honki desu

104725.description: A love story depicting a female elementary school student in love with a high school student.

104726.description:
The drop-dead-gorgeous and high-sex-appeal Akasaka Hibiki is going through breakup blues. Soon after being dumped, she's asked to become her schoolmate Aoyama-kun's mistress?! Aoyama-kun will try to gain Hibiki's affections through different means, so let's just hope he doesn't nosebleed to death in the process.

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

104727.description: Amane Anzu, a high school student, is actively looking for a boyfriend. However, most candidates tend to quickly lose interest when they find out she's actually a real divorcee. And if that's still not enough to drive guys away, the fact she has a daughter usually does the trick.

104728.description:
This is a school love story where Yi Lin bumps into the tomboy Ruo Xi, sparking an interest between each other that slowly blooms. "Is that true? I, fall in love with a girl?" "Why every time I saw her my heart is beating faster?" "How many times does she notice my burning face?" Yi Lin and Ruo Xi both need an answer to go on.

(Source: Webcomics)

104729.description:
Xia Yuxun's presence at school never fails to draw attention. She has a mature beauty about her, always poised, and exuding confidence in class. Being admired so much by her classmates, one would think she's a well-respected senior but in truth, it might be because she's a repeat student. Xia Yuxun has more to her elegant facade.

(Source: Webcomics)

104730.description:
Serialization of the original doujin

Handyman Saitou has never been anyone special. All his life, he’s had average grades, ordinary athletic skill, a commonplace job… But his unremarkable path takes a turn when he wakes up in another world. Here, warriors, wizards, and elves accompany him on quests delving deep into dungeons, and Saitou realizes for the first time what it’s like to be needed. After all, who other than the handyman could be trusted to open locked treasure chests or repair his allies’ equipment? Beginning with a simple “thank you,” this is the story of an ordinary person’s fulfilling life. 

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: 便利屋斎藤さん、異世界に行く

104731.description:
I just finished University, yet I travelled back to high school! I was a guy, but suddenly transformed into a girl!

God gave me another chance, and I've decided to stop being good! I shall change history and conquer the high school! I will become the queen!

104732.description:
A collection of works released in Girls' Jump and Girls' Jump Kai.

Take a peek, if you will, into the private lives of the young and love-struck. Not the public things that everyone sees, but the messy parts that take place in the secrecy of the home. You’ll find that life, like love, is an inexplicable and chaotic thing. All the more entertaining, don’t you think?

104733.description:
"My life has totally fallen apart..." Haruko was 29, with both her 30s and a blissful marriage right on the horizon, when her fiance dropped a bomb that tore that happiness to shreds. Her friends and family do their best to cheer her up afterward, but she just can't shake the suffocating feeling that plagues her days. If only, she wishes, there were someplace where it would be easier to breathe... And that's when her old classmate Asano invites her to come join him in bustling big-city Tokyo! She went from the top of the world to rock bottom so fast, she didn't even see the precipice she'd been standing on, but now Haruko is taking the reins and starting over from square one!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

104734.description: The manga starts with Kazuki, a university student in Tokyo, visiting her family during spring break. At first, her parents were pleased by her visit, but Kazuki doesn’t return to Tokyo even after a few days. And then one day she just tells her parents that she left university. She has no aspirations and so starts the story with her; she is being lazy at home as a ‘bonkura musume’.

title.native: ボンクラボンボンハウス

104736.description:
"I want to believe in my first love.
But then we met."

25-year-old Miku, who moved back to the house she grew up in two months ago, is studying to succeed her grandfather's Chinese medicine store, "Kusuriya Kyubee." Everyday she and her grandfather respond to the troubles of the customers who visit the store, prepare herbal medicine for them, or simply chat with them.

On the other hand, Miku is unable to forget her first love, but she meets an ultra-shy boy named Kanae who likes plants. Perhaps she is beginning to care about him little by little.

title.native: ねむようこと雑な草たち
title.romaji: Nemu Youko to Zatsu na Kusatachi

104742.description:
Tells the story of Atsurou Tanaka, a man who is ambivalent about visiting the sauna until one day he is turned on to their charms by the mysterious Mushi-Z ("Steamy-Z"). Atsurou develops a passion for saunas, and he travels Japan visiting various saunas and having conversations with other sauna enthusiasts like Guuzen-san ("Mr. Coincidence") and Ikemen Mushi Otoko ("Handsome Steamy Man").

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: マンガ サ道~マンガで読むサウナ道~
title.romaji: Manga Sadou: Manga de Yomu Sauna-dou

title.native: オッス! トン子ちゃん

104744.description:
The story is set in Kyoto, and centers on the adolescent years of Takatoyo, focusing on his uncertain and fleeting nature.

(Source: Anime News Network)

104747.description: A doujin by Morinaga Milk and Hakamada Mera released at COMITIA 122 featuring sequel chapters to their respective series, Girl Friends and Fuwa Fuwa Futashika Yume Mitai.

104751.description:
The manga's story centers on Fumio, a high school student who hates rap. When his father, who is a rapper, is injured and cannot attend a rap battle event, Fumio decides to take his place.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: Includes an extra.

104752.description:
Originally published on Syosetu prior to serialisation.

Crown prince Cecil was so brilliant that everything in life was easy to the point of boring him, then one day, his fiancée Bertia suddenly said "Prince Cecil, I am a villainess!" Claiming that this world is the same as that of an "otome game" from her past life and that she is playing the role of the "villainess" in it, she aims to play her part well and have their engagement annulled. With that goal in mind, she sets about causing turmoil in Cecil's daily life.
synonyms: Observation Record of a Self-proclaimed Villainess’ Fiance
บันทึกสังเกตการณ์คู่หมั้นผู้ประกาศตัวเป็นนางร้าย

104753.description: A Twilight Zone/Outer Limits-esque romp through the occult and supernatural led by your elven-eared hostess, Misery.

104754.description: The elven-eared Misery is our guide to the Outer Zone, a place where reality and dreams collide (similar to The Outer Limits or The Twilight Zone). Humans, and even animals, sometimes find themselves wandering into this place on the edge of reality. For example, the first story involves a manga assistant who buys a love doll that is more than it seems, and the second is about a poor abandoned cat who is trying to find a way to survive in a cold park. Each chapter focuses on a different encounter with the supernatural!

title.native: アウターゾーン リ:ビジテッド

synonyms: Follow Primula-san At the Coffee Shop

title.native: 純喫茶のプリムラさん

104756.description:
Serialisation of the novel originally published on Syosetu.

Sansui Shirokuro is a young guy with an old man's name, which ends up landing him in tragic circumstances when God snuffs out his life candle after mistaking him for a geezer whose time has passed. Now reincarnated into a fantasy world, Sansui is one of the Immortals, capable of immense power... as long as he's willing to put centuries of work into achieving it. One day, after five hundred years of swinging his sword, his monotonous existence is upended entirely by the appearance of a little baby. His master sends him out into the world to raise the child, and it's there that he meets a haughty young noblewoman and her tomboyish bodyguard. His fighting style may be bland and unpretentious, but the fast-paced mortal world is about to find out just how good even the most hopeless swordsman can get with half a millennium of practice behind him!

(Source: J-Novel Club)
synonyms: Jimi na Kensei Sore Demo Saikyou desu

title.english: The World's Least Interesting Master Swordsman
title.native: 地味な剣聖はそれでも最強です
title.romaji: Jimi na Kensei Soredemo Saikyou desu

104757.description:
Due to a divine mistake, Sansui Shirokuro meets an untimely death.

To make up for it, he’s sent to another world. He wishes to be fawned over in classic I’m OP fashion, but when he tells that to God, he somehow ends up training under the hermit Suiboku…

Five hundred years later, when he’s become a full-fledged hermit, Sansui stumbles upon an abandoned baby. He names the child Rein and ventures into the world to raise her…

Thus, the hermit with a baby begins his parenting.

(Source: Manga Mirai)

Even if the Sword Saint is Boring He's Still the Strongest
Jimina Ken Sei Wa Sore Demo Saikyoudesu

104758.description: Mimi starts working at a family restaurant to help cure her fear of people. She finds that the employee assisting her, Kamisaka, is extremely nice. Her heart goes DOKI DOKI when she sees the way he works.
synonyms: Thank you for waiting. This is my first love.

title.native: お待たせしました、初恋です。

104759.description:
Serialisation of the novel originally published on Syosetu.

Alan is the strongest miner in the world, able to reduce mountains to rubble with simply a swing of his trusty shovel. But when Princess Letitia begs him to escort her on a quest to save her kingdom from an invading demon force, he agrees to leave his solitary mountain abode and venture forth, on one condition: she must help him find a successor to train. In this hilarious fantasy tale for fans of RPGs, evil doesn’t stand a chance against the mighty power of the shovel!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Nishimura Akane is a black sheep in her class, and not a day passes without her classmates picking on her. But Takada Taiyou is new and has no clue why they would treat her that way. Will his straightforward nature become a ray of sunshine in Nishimura's gloomy days? Let their wholesome story bring you back to the carefree times of your youth!
